name: train-progress
description: A side panel with live progress bars for your ML training jobs

scope.title: Jobs to show
scope.description: all shows every training job on this machine; session shows only jobs started from the current Claude Code session. The panel's button and /train all|session switch it for the session.

logRoots.title: Extra TensorBoard log folders
logRoots.description: Comma-separated folders to watch for TensorBoard runs, besides each session's <project>/logs.

watcher.title: Watch TensorBoard logs
watcher.description: Run the TensorBoard watcher (python3) so runs that log only to TensorBoard show up.
